sanskrit: payo mahyam oṣadhayaḥ payo me vīrudho dadhan | apāṃ payasvad yat payas tan me varṣantu vṛṣṭayaḥ ||
english: May the plants grant me nourishment, may the herbs grant me nourishment; whatever milky nourishment is in the waters — may the rain-showers shower that down upon me.

sanskrit: payo mahyaṃ payasvanto hastino me payo dadhan | payaḥ patatriṇo mahyam aiṇeyā me payo dadhan ||
english: May the nourishment-full elephants grant me nourishment; may the birds grant nourishment to me; may the black-antelope grant me nourishment.

sanskrit: payasvan me kṣetram astu payasvad uta dhānyam | ahaṃ payasvān bhūyāsaṃ gāvo ma uta payasvatīḥ ||
english: Let my field be rich in nourishment, and my grain rich in nourishment; may I myself become nourishment-rich, and my cows likewise milk-full.

sanskrit: payo mahyam apsaraso gandharvā me payo dadhan | payo me viśvā bhūtāni vāto dadhātu me payaḥ ||
english: May the Apsarases grant me nourishment, may the Gandharvas grant me nourishment; may all beings grant me nourishment — may the Wind bestow nourishment upon me.

sanskrit: payo mahyaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ payo dadhat | payo ma indraś cāgniś ca dhātā dadhātu me payaḥ ||
english: May Heaven-and-Earth grant me nourishment, may the atmosphere grant nourishment; may Indra and Agni grant me nourishment — may Dhātṛ bestow nourishment upon me.

sanskrit: ahaṃ bibharmi te mano ahaṃ cittam ahaṃ vratam | mamed api kratāv aso mama citte sacāvahai ||
english: I bear your mind, I bear your thought, I bear your vow; may you be within my resolve as well — let us be united in my thought.

sanskrit: āmanā asa ihamanā asa iha te ramatāṃ manaḥ | mayi te ramatāṃ manaḥ ||
english: Be hither-minded, be here-minded; may your mind take delight here — may your mind take delight in me.

sanskrit: āñjanasya madhughasya kuṣṭhasya naladasya ca | vīrodekasya mūlena mukhe nimandanaṃ kṛtam ||
english: With the root of vīrodeka — of āñjana, of madhugha, of kuṣṭha and of nalada — an enchantment has been placed upon the mouth.

sanskrit: madhu me antar āsye mukhe nimandanaṃ kṛtam | tatro tvaṃ vi vartasva narācīva vartasi ||
english: Sweetness within my mouth, an enchantment has been made in the mouth; there now turn you about — you spin like an iron-headed arrow.

sanskrit: yathā nemī rathacakraṃ samantaṃ pariṣasvaje | evā pari ṣvajasva mā yathāsan mayi te manaḥ ||
english: As the felloe embraces the wheel of a chariot on every side, so embrace me entirely — so let it be that your mind remains in me.

sanskrit: yathedam aśvinā tṛṇaṃ vāto vahati bhūmyāḥ | evā vayaṃ vahāmasi yāṃ vayaṃ kāmayāmahe ||
english: As the wind, O Aśvins, carries this blade of grass from the earth, so we carry her whom we desire.

sanskrit: ut tvā mātā sthāpayatu pra tvā nudatām aśvinā | adhā śiśur iva mātaraṃ mām evānv etu te manaḥ ||
english: May your mother raise you up; may the Aśvins impel you forward; then, as a child turns toward its mother, may your mind follow me alone.

sanskrit: yathā kṣīraṃ ca sarpiś ca manuṣyāṇāṃ hṛdaḥ priyam | evāham asyā nāryā hṛdo bhūyāsam uttaraḥ ||
english: As milk and clarified butter are dear to the hearts of human beings, so may I become the highest and most cherished in this woman's heart.

sanskrit: agneṣ ṭvā tapas tapatu vātasya dhrājiḥ | mā spṛkṣathā niṣadanāya sādhava ut tiṣṭha prehy agnivat te kṛṇomi ||
english: May Agni's heat burn you; the rushing gust of the wind — let it not touch you toward sitting still. Come, good one — arise and go forth! I make you like fire.

sanskrit: sūryasya tvā tapas tapatu vātasya dhrājiḥ | mā spṛkṣathā niṣadanāya sādhava ut tiṣṭha prehi sūryavat te kṛṇomi ||
english: May the Sun's heat burn you; the rushing gust of the wind — let it not touch you toward sitting still. Come, good one — arise and go forth! I make you like the Sun.
